title: Snake
long_description:
Snake is a self-contained single-page HTML5 game from the Omega Games library. Classic snake — eat, grow, survive. Swipe direction or use arrow keys. Speed increases as you grow.

Controls: keyboard (arrow keys / WASD) or swipe. No installation, no account, no external network calls — the whole game is one HTML file that runs entirely in the browser tab it's loaded in.

It's an action/reflex title: quick decisions and quick hands matter more than planning.

Built for embedding: the page has no iframe-blocking headers, so it drops straight into a portal frame at any size. Session length is short (seconds to a few minutes per round), which fits browsing/portal traffic patterns rather than a long-form download.

Source id: snake. Part of a 21-title batch of small HTML5 games being submitted from the same library — if you like this one, the others share the same lightweight, dependency-free build.
